3830548217.title: 招募候选刷新 | Recruitment Refresh
3830548217.description:
[h1]招募候选刷新 / Recruitment Refresh[/h1]
[b]0.3.1 Alpha · 超凡帝国 · Windows x64 / WH3 9.0.5[/b]

[b]必需物品：memreader Plus，请订阅并同时启用。此次单机实测依赖版本 0.15.2。[/b] 迁都为[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3830651933]独立 Mod[/url]，两者互不依赖。

在普通领主/事务官招募页选择类别，点击底部“招募”右侧的刷新图标。免费，无额外回合冷却，单击直接刷新、不弹确认；选中的非空普通子类型不足 3 人时补足到 3 人，更多候选保持人数，不会持续累加。原版建筑、容量、费用和内容解锁条件保持。

传奇、唯一、不朽、受伤、已招募及未知履历人物受到保护。商队、车队、冰雪宫廷训练、仪式及特殊来源不支持。空池不补员，旧档未知履历人物可能被保护，后续自然生成的普通候选才会获得可刷新履历。其他修改候选生成/招募池的 Mod 可能冲突，不宣称全种族或组合 Mod 兼容。

[h2]实验性联机支持[/h2]
[b]0.3.0 已加入多人同步，但未做联机实机验收，不保证无失步。[/b] 全部玩家须启用完全相同的本 Mod 包（包括语言）、memreader Plus 及其他 Mod/依赖版本。各端先关闭人物面板、比对版本/候选计划后执行，再核对结果。联机刷新会关闭所有端的人物面板，完成后需手动重开；单机仍自动返回招募页。

混用版本、缺少 Mod、断线或成员变化可能拒绝或持续等待。原生调用单端失败不能自动回滚；结果不明或部分完成时停止操作，不自动重试。保留操作前独立存档，异常后读回该档，不手动清除锁。

0.3.1 修复同职业多法术系可能选错刷新目标、鼠标悬停选中态未识别、刷新后返回默认法术系/分类，以及开局普通候选履历观察遗漏。9.0.5 高精单机实测：生命系 1→3、高等系 6→6、王子分类刷新、未知履历人物保留、正常招募及按钮避让；其他法术系候选保持不变。[b]本机没有巴什瓦角色包授权，爪语者未直接实测；按用户确认，以同机制多法术系验收后发布。联机仍未实机验收。[/b] 空间不足时隐藏图标。缺少依赖或引擎构建/原生结构未通过验证时停止刷新。禁用 Mod 不会撤销已保存的刷新和招募。

[h2]English[/h2]
Requires memreader Plus enabled alongside this Mod (SP tested with 0.15.2). Free one-click ordinary lord/hero candidate refresh in Immortal Empires, using the small icon beside Recruit. A selected nonempty ordinary subtype fills to at least 3; larger pools retain their size and repeated refreshes do not accumulate candidates. Normal buildings, capacity, gold and content requirements remain. Legendary, unique, immortal, wounded, recruited and unknown-history characters are protected. Empty pools, caravans/convoys, special training and ritual recruitment are excluded.

[b]0.3.0 adds EXPERIMENTAL multiplayer synchronization; native multiplayer has NOT been tested. OOS-free operation is not guaranteed.[/b] All players need identical Mod packages (including language), memreader Plus and matching other Mods/dependencies. All peers close character panels, compare versions/candidate plans, execute and compare results. MP panels must be reopened manually afterward; SP still reopens automatically. Mixed versions, missing Mods, disconnects or membership changes may reject or stall operations. Native failure on one peer cannot be rolled back automatically. Keep a pre-operation save; restore it after uncertainty instead of retrying or clearing locks.

0.3.1 fixes wrong-lore targeting on shared agent tabs, selected-hover detection, restoring the native lore/category after refresh, and startup candidate-history observation. High Elf SP regression on Windows x64 / 9.0.5 covers Life 1→3, High Magic 6→6, Prince category refresh, protected unknown-history candidates, normal recruitment and native-control clearance; other lore pools remain unchanged. [b]Clawspeakers were NOT directly tested because this machine lacks the Bhashiva Character Pack license. Release uses equivalent multi-lore native acceptance with the user's explicit approval. Native multiplayer remains untested.[/b] No universal faction or overhaul compatibility claim.
